sources.title: List of countries that do not need a visa for Trinidad and Tobago
sources.publisher: Immigration Division, Ministry of Homeland Security
sources.officialityEvidence: The live PDF is served from the Ministry of Homeland Security's official nationalsecurity.gov.tt domain and states its named-country waiver rule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Citizens of the countries listed below do not require visas for entry

sources.title: Visa Application Instructions
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign and CARICOM Affairs
sources.officialityEvidence: The September 2025 instructions are published on the Ministry's official foreign.gov.tt domain.
sources.supportingExcerpt: All entry visas for Trinidad and Tobago are now electronic.

sources.title: Visa Online Services
sources.publisher: Immigration Division, Ministry of Homeland Security
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Ministry of Homeland Security page links the official eVisa application service and Immigration Division contacts.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Bona fide operating crew ... do not require a visa, regardless of nationality.

sources.title: eVISA Frequently Asked Questions
sources.publisher: Immigration Division, Ministry of Homeland Security
sources.officialityEvidence: The FAQ is directly linked from the Ministry's live eVisa service and describes its approved-visa delivery workflow.
sources.supportingExcerpt: your Visa will be included as an attachment in the email.

sources.title: Visa & Student Permit
sources.officialityEvidence: The Government information portal identifies Immigration Division as the service provider and describes the current eVisa process.
sources.supportingExcerpt: eligible foreign nationals from visa-required countries can apply for a Multiple Entry eVisa
